children: The soybean market is still wondering which country President Trump was referring to when he told CNBC yesterday that he had made an "unbelievable trade deal" and that "they're going to buy much more soybeans, much more everything." Some think China, while others have their doubts. AgResource says it doesn't see the deal involving China which has already committed to buying 25 million metric tons of U.S. soybeans, "and additional supplies would further strain the state reserve system." The firm says it suspects the deal could involve the EU or even Mexico. (anthony.harrup@wsj.com)
